filter: absolute 10/20-bar displacement divided by sum of absolute close-to-close changes through signal candle
entry: next open, if efficiency ratio on signal candle meets threshold
exit: opposite EMA crossing closes the prior position even when filter blocks the new entry
primary_screen: strictly positive return in every complete calendar month; no zero month
control: EMA12/33 without efficiency filter on same candles and costs
candidate_policy: no candidate if no fixed variant passes monthly screen; late sample is already seen
